patch_description: This new ansatz block keeps the same overall training pipeline and feature map, but changes the variational structure to be more parameter-efficient and less prone to train-test mismatch. Concretely: it (1) uses strong parameter sharing for all single-qubit rotations (only 6–8 unique parameters per block), (2) uses a fixed CZ ring pattern for entanglement (no extra parameters), (3) adds a single shared CRZ parameter on a set of paired edges to introduce controlled nonlinearity, and (4) adds a global trainable RZ “phase-tuning” parameter at the end of the block to stabilize optimization and improve calibration without increasing expressivity too much.
